frames.label: hit-E-01-v1
frames.pose: 01 initial impact. Body still nearly upright facing right; knees begin to bend, chin draws slightly back; left bell elbow tightens at waist, right five-card fan rises from low guard to chest. Both shoes planted y920, ponytail/red ties only begin lifting toward right. This precedes deeper knee compression in 02.

frames.label: hit-E-02-v1
frames.pose: 02 compression. Bend both knees more than 01; pelvis remains x512 and torso leans backward about 10 degrees; eyebrows pinch and mouth tenses. Left bell lifted to lower ribs; far right fan shields upper chest. Front knee folds, rear foot bears weight; ponytail/red ties trail right. Shallower lean than peak03.

frames.label: hit-E-03-v1
frames.pose: 03 deepest backward recoil. Bent knees, rear left-screen foot bears weight, chest leans screen-left about20 degrees, head recoils up/left but eyes squint toward right. Left bell below chest, right five-card fan guards upper chest. Ponytail and ties trail right, hem lifts. Feet retain y920.

frames.label: hit-E-04-v1
frames.pose: 04 elastic rebound from peak03. Torso comes forward to about12 degrees backward lean, chin returns down; knees still bent but extending. Left bell descends slightly below ribs; right fan guard lowers toward mid-chest. Ponytail begins overswing left while tassel still trails right. Distinct recovery pose with grounded feet.

frames.label: hit-E-05-v1
frames.pose: 05 recovery. Torso only5 degrees backward lean, knees nearly straight; strained eyes open toward right. Left bell drops to waist, far right fan opens at lower chest; hem settles but red ties still angle left. Compared04, elbows are lower and chest farther forward; retain planted feet.

frames.label: hit-E-06-v1
frames.pose: 06 alert settle. Upright right-facing ready guard with soft bent knees, left bell beside forward hip and right five-card fan at waist/chest; determined closed mouth, ponytail settling behind. This is a newly drawn combat settle pose, not copied idle. Left wrist slightly rotated from05 and elbows relaxed.

frames.label: attack-E-01-v1
frames.pose: 01 prepare. Right-facing ready stance, knees soft, left bell held low at near hip, right five-card fan drawn slightly rearward behind lower ribs; focused eyes. Chest turns a few degrees away from target to begin windup. Shoes anchored y920.

frames.label: attack-E-02-v1
frames.pose: 02 draw back. Knees bend deeper; right far elbow pulls fan rearward/up behind shoulder silhouette while all five talismans remain visible; left bell moves inward in front of abdomen. Upper torso coils away from screen-right, red ties begin lagging right.

frames.label: attack-E-03-v1
frames.pose: 03 maximum windup. Deepest preparation crouch; right fan hand cocked beside back shoulder, fan angled upward; left bell tucked close at solar plexus. Torso coiled, head still looks right. Rear foot loads; front heel light but toe remains at ground. Distinct from02: fan higher and torso more twisted.

frames.label: attack-E-04-v1
frames.pose: 04 acceleration. Uncoil chest toward right; right forearm sweeps fan forward from back shoulder to beside cheek, elbow still bent. Left bell stays near ribs to clear swing. Front knee begins taking weight, rear heel rises slightly, toes remain planted y920. Ponytail follows late.

frames.label: attack-E-05-v1
frames.pose: 05 contact pose. Short forceful forward fan strike toward screen-right at shoulder height; anatomical right arm nearly straight on far side, all five red talismans visible as one fan. Left bell kept near chest on camera side. Torso leans15 degrees forward; leading knee bent, back heel raised, toe ground y920. Focused expression, no impact VFX.

frames.label: attack-E-06-v1
frames.pose: 06 strike peak. Right fan hand reaches a little farther and lower than05, right elbow extends to full safe reach; chest twist completes forward. Left bell held just below sternum. Weight fully front foot, rear toe stays planted. Ponytail and coat flare left from forward motion. Do not enlarge character or fan.

frames.label: attack-E-07-v1
frames.pose: 07 follow-through. Right fan travels down to lower-chest target height beyond extended arm, elbow begins softening. Torso starts reducing forward lean, leading knee remains bent; left bell moves slightly outward near hip to counterbalance. Hair/hem still trail left.

frames.label: attack-E-08-v1
frames.pose: 08 begin retract. Right elbow draws fan back to just ahead of chest; fan tilts upright. Left bell lowers beside waist. Body returns toward center x512, rear heel comes toward ground. Chin and eyes stay on right target. Less extension than07, sleeves fold naturally.

frames.label: attack-E-09-v1
frames.pose: 09 mid retract. Right fan held vertically near ribs, right elbow behind torso; left bell at forward hip; torso almost upright and weight redistributes across both shoes. Ponytail overswings slightly toward right, robe hem drops.

frames.label: attack-E-10-v1
frames.pose: 10 guard reset. Both shoes flat at y920; right fan rotates outward toward ready angle at waist/chest; left bell lowered with bent wrist. Knees softly bent, torso upright; face relaxes from strike concentration. Fan lower than09 and bell slightly forward.

frames.label: attack-E-11-v1
frames.pose: 11 settle. Right fan eases a little down toward normal guard, left bell shifts closer to thigh, torso has tiny backward settling motion while eyes still right. Ties and tassel overswing less; knees remain soft.

frames.label: attack-E-12-v1
frames.pose: 12 final alert ready. Balanced upright combat guard, right fan open at lower chest, left bell near-camera hip, gaze right; tassel hangs with slight residual curve, ponytail nearly settled. Distinct new drawing and slight wrist/arm difference from11, no copied idle.

frames.label: cast-E-01-v1
frames.pose: 01 begin ritual. Upright right-facing guard, left bell begins rising from hip toward waist, right five-card fan moves inward at abdomen. Focused eyes, knees soft, feet planted y920. A small preparatory turn of shoulders.

frames.label: cast-E-02-v1
frames.pose: 02 gather hands. Left bell rises to lower chest, elbow bent; right fan gathers closer across belly at upward diagonal. Knees bend slightly and shoulders draw together. Red tassel starts to swing rearward.

frames.label: cast-E-03-v1
frames.pose: 03 raise bell. Left near-camera forearm lifts bronze bell to shoulder level in front of chest; right fan tilts vertically beside ribs. Torso lowers slightly on bent knees, gaze right, crown unchanged. Hands clearly distinct.

frames.label: cast-E-04-v1
frames.pose: 04 opening ritual. Left bell reaches beside cheek at eye level, left elbow outward; right fan raised across chest but below chin. Chest turns slightly toward camera, both feet stay planted. Deeper crouch than03; no floating glyphs.

frames.label: cast-E-05-v1
frames.pose: 05 concentrate. Left bell held above cheek, wrist pronates to tilt bell mouth outward; right fan hand draws back beside far shoulder ready to aim. Head lowers a little, amber eyes narrow, knees compressed. Ties droop slightly.

frames.label: cast-E-06-v1
frames.pose: 06 higher focus. Left bell lifted just above crown-side height without covering face; right fan angled diagonally upward near shoulder. Torso begins straightening out of crouch, front knee advances; bell tassel swings sideways from wrist motion.

frames.label: cast-E-07-v1
frames.pose: 07 poised release. Left bell high beside forehead, wrist cocked for a ring; right fan starts moving forward past shoulder with elbow bent90 degrees. Chest opens toward screen-right, knees extend. Ponytail starts trailing left.

frames.label: cast-E-08-v1
frames.pose: 08 final anticipation. Left bell arcs forward from above brow to eye height, mouth tilted toward right; right fan reaches midway forward at face/chest height, elbow still distinctly bent. Torso leans forward7 degrees and front knee loads. Next09 will extend the fan fully.

frames.label: cast-E-09-v1
frames.pose: 09 release. Strong clean casting gesture toward screen-right: right far arm extends five-card fan forward at shoulder height, left near-camera bell lifted forward near cheek with wrist flicked, tassel thrown toward right. Torso leans12 degrees, front knee bent, rear heel lightly lifted but toe grounded y920. Eyes focused. No rendered spell effects.

frames.label: cast-E-10-v1
frames.pose: 10 sustained release. Right fan extends slightly farther and tips downward10 degrees; left bell finishes wrist flick and drops a little below cheek, tassel swings ahead. Chest twist completes and chin advances, front knee holds. Distinct joint pose from09 with no particles.

frames.label: cast-E-11-v1
frames.pose: 11 withdraw bell. Left bell retracts toward upper chest, elbow folds; right fan starts bending back from full reach to forward guard. Torso forward lean eases to8 degrees, rear heel begins lowering. Ponytail still trails left.

frames.label: cast-E-12-v1
frames.pose: 12 withdraw fan. Right fan comes back toward shoulder/chest, elbow bent, fan upright; left bell lowers to sternum. Body rises toward vertical, weight centers x512; leading knee starts straightening. Hem falls.

frames.label: cast-E-13-v1
frames.pose: 13 close ritual. Right fan lowers from chest toward waist and turns outward; left bell settles at lower ribs, wrist untwists. Torso upright with soft knees, both shoes flat y920. Tassel overswings gently left.

frames.label: cast-E-14-v1
frames.pose: 14 return guard. Right fan at waist/chest open guard angle, left bell moves down beside near hip; shoulders relax but gaze right stays alert. Hair ties drift right as they settle; knees nearly normal ready position.

frames.label: cast-E-15-v1
frames.pose: 15 settling breath. Right fan slightly raised from14 to final guard, left bell held low but elbow still softly bent; small chest lift and chin relaxes, body remains planted. Tassel nearly vertical, ponytail settling.

frames.label: cast-E-16-v1
frames.pose: 16 final ready. Right-facing balanced combat guard with right five-card fan lower-chest and left near-camera bronze bell beside hip; calm focused face, knees relaxed. Newly drawn final settle, tiny wrist/shoulder difference from15, no copied idle.
